items.context: With Ao3 down I decided to pick of video games again. I wanted something cozy and not too intensive. I found Dressmaker. I have already "finished" Dressmaker. I really loved Dressmaker.
items.text: Dressmaker sounds like a lovely find for a quiet evening. Glad it hit the spot.

items.text: Congrats on number 23! If you want something calm and easy to learn, Unpacking is a gentle one: no timer, no way to lose, just settling into a space.
